_about: The Roadmap page's data (pages/roadmap/body.py draws it). To change the page, change this file: an idea's status is one of the statuses below (a ready idea also gets version, the add-on version it came out in, and shows in the Ready section at the top; an in-progress idea also gets version, the version it is expected in), its group one of the groups. Every title and text is English, translated in site_tr.py's Roadmap block; the build stops on one without a translation. No dates. The numbers are the roadmap's own (32 is left out at the player's wish). Every "name", "title" and "text" is listed for translation by keys_all.py ("_translate").

statuses.name: Ready
statuses.text: Out now, in the version shown.

statuses.name: In progress
statuses.text: Being built now, for the version shown.

statuses.name: Next
statuses.text: Small, wanted, and first in line.

statuses.name: Planned
statuses.text: On the list, to be built.

statuses.name: Thinking about it
statuses.text: An idea we like, not decided yet.

groups.name: Levelling
groups.text: The route planner, quests and your characters.

groups.name: Gold
groups.text: Ways to make gold, prices and the auction house.

groups.name: For everyone
groups.text: The whole interface, accessibility and the website.

groups.name: Behind the scenes
groups.text: What keeps the add-on fast, safe and tested.

ideas.title: Professions on the route
ideas.text: Training, gathering and crafting for your professions, fitted into the route.

ideas.title: Dungeon runs in the plan
ideas.text: Dungeons at the right level, with their quests, as part of the route.

ideas.title: Shared plans for guilds
ideas.text: A route your guild can share, so everyone levels the same way.

ideas.title: Learning from many players
ideas.text: Better routes from how many players level, only from those who choose to share. Privacy first.

ideas.title: Planning for a group
ideas.text: One route for three to five players, the way planning with a friend works today.

ideas.title: Where your gold went
ideas.text: A history of what you earned and spent, by kind, over days and weeks.

ideas.title: Sharing price scans
ideas.text: Share your auction prices with friends and your guild, so everyone has fresh ones.

ideas.title: Posting helper
ideas.text: A suggested price and stack size when you post an auction. You still press Post yourself.

ideas.title: Mail and expired auctions
ideas.text: Your auction mail, sold, bought and expired, in one clear list.

ideas.title: Season-start mode
ideas.text: A route made for the busy first days of a new season.

ideas.title: Planner and gold settings in packs and codes
ideas.text: The planner's and the gold window's settings saved in packs and profile codes, like the rest of your setup.

ideas.title: Controller and Steam Deck
ideas.text: Playing with a controller, on a Steam Deck too.

ideas.title: Accessibility, round two
ideas.text: Directions spoken aloud, and a high-contrast arrow and route.

ideas.title: More on the website
ideas.text: An interactive tour, a preview of a route, and video captions in every language.

ideas.title: A speed budget
ideas.text: Tests that stop the add-on from getting any slower.

ideas.title: Crash reports, if you want
ideas.text: A report to send when something breaks, only if you choose to.

ideas.title: Rested experience planner
ideas.text: Where and when to log out, so you start your next session with the most rested experience.

ideas.title: Danger on the route
ideas.text: Warnings about dangerous places on the route, and routes that keep away from them if you want.

ideas.title: Gear plan
ideas.text: The quest rewards and drops that would be upgrades for you, planned in.

ideas.title: Reputation goals
ideas.text: Pick a standing with a faction, and see the quickest way there.

ideas.title: Talent plan by level
ideas.text: A talent build that says what to pick at each level.

ideas.title: Which character today?
ideas.text: A look across all your characters, and which one has the most to gain from today's session.

ideas.title: Collector's planner
ideas.text: Rare monsters, pets and mounts, and a route to go after them.

ideas.title: Guides anyone can write
ideas.text: A guide format other players can write for, checked before it is used, and never running code.

ideas.title: Players' theme gallery
ideas.text: A gallery on the website of themes that players made, to try and to share.

ideas.title: Streamer mode
ideas.text: One switch that hides the names and chat you don't want on stream.

ideas.title: A check after each game patch
ideas.text: A look at login after a game patch, which tells you if something no longer works.

ideas.title: Saved-data tidy and backup
ideas.text: Old saved data tidied away, and a backup of your settings kept.

ideas.title: Catch-up for returning players
ideas.text: Back after a break? Where you were, and what to do first.

ideas.title: Hunter pet and warlock demon helper
ideas.text: Help with taming pets, teaching them their skills, and the warlock's demon quests.

ideas.title: Class quests on time
ideas.text: A heads-up before each class quest, so you are ready for it at the right level.

ideas.title: Price alerts
ideas.text: A note when something you want shows up cheap at the auction house.

ideas.title: Sorting by value
ideas.text: Sort your bags and bank by what things are worth.

ideas.title: Crafting queue
ideas.text: A list of what to craft, with what you still need for it.

ideas.title: Guild progress board
ideas.text: A board that shows how your guild is getting on, for guilds that turn it on.

ideas.title: Ask the guide in chat
ideas.text: Ask the guide a question in chat, such as where a quest starts, and get an answer.

ideas.title: Seasonal themes
ideas.text: Themes for the time of year.

ideas.title: Sound pack
ideas.text: Sounds made for the interface, to switch on if you like.

ideas.title: Larger text everywhere
ideas.text: One switch that makes all of the add-on's text larger.

ideas.title: Help with translations
ideas.text: A page on the website for players who would like to help translate.

ideas.title: Patch notes in the game
ideas.text: What's new, shown in the game the first time you log in after an update.

ideas.title: A beta channel
ideas.text: Early test versions on CurseForge, for players who like to try new things first.
